claims.label: Host Says Five Rental Vehicles Tied to Duncan Aviation and the "Egyptian" Arrival Chain Were Identified by License Plate
claims.claim: The host says five specific rental vehicles with documented license plates are the verified rental fleet associated with the Duncan Aviation / "Egyptian" group.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Duncan Aviation rental contracts, cross-check plate state-DMV registrations, and verify renter identities against the SU-BTT passenger manifest.

claims.label: A UVU Student Told CNN He Saw a Man on or Near the Losee Center Roof Twice in Two Weeks
claims.claim: Per the CNN article the host shows, a UVU student told CNN he observed a tall, thin white male in dark clothing with a backpack on or near the Losee Center roof twice, the last time at noon the Wednesday before the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the student and the reportedly-present professor; obtain any contemporaneous photographs, texts to the FBI tip line, and UVU building access logs for the CS building concourse and roof.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Kirk's Security Lead Texted the UVU Police Chief About Rooftop Access and Accepted "I Got You Covered" as Resolution
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Brian Harpole, Charlie Kirk's security lead, reads his texts to UVU Police Chief Jeff Long about student roof access near where Kirk would be set up, ending with the reply "I got you covered," and the host says Harpole did not follow up further.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full text thread and timestamp metadata; confirm whether UVU PD logged any rooftop security assignment; check TPUSA advance-team documentation.

claims.label: Blake Neff was standing next to Mikey McCoy at the moment of the shooting.
claims.claim: Blake Neff states that he and Mikey McCoy were side-by-side when the shot occurred, both turned, and both saw Kirk had been shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference video from TPUSA / event cameras and Stage area microphones; verify Neff's position with other contemporaneous witness accounts.

claims.label: Per Blake Neff's Screenshot the Host Shows, His Call to His Mother Began at 11:24 Arizona Time and Lasted 45 Seconds
claims.claim: Per a screenshot of Blake Neff's phone that the host shows, his call to his mother was initiated at 11:24 Arizona time (12:24 Utah time) and lasted 45 seconds.
claims.investigative_direction: Independently confirm the phone metadata; obtain Neff's carrier records; map against Mikey McCoy's call to Erika and call to Rob McCoy.

claims.label: Audience Questioner at Rob McCoy's Jerusalem Event Says Carlson and Owens Are Hijacking the Christian Message
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays from a Jerusalem event she says was billed as a celebration of Charlie Kirk's life, an audience questioner says Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens are 'essentially trying to hijack the Christian message and spread an anti-Israel message in the name of Christianity'; Rob McCoy answers that it is a great question.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the uncut event recording; identify the questioner and the host organization; review the event's sponsor and attendee list.

claims.label: Host Shows Calvary Chapel Magazine Cover With "Stand with Israel" and "Why Jews Are Hated" Article, Interior Featuring IDF Soldiers
claims.claim: The host shows what she says is this month's Calvary Chapel magazine cover, sent to her by someone, featuring "Stand with Israel" and a "Why Jews are hated" subtitle, and says the interior includes a photo of IDF soldiers wearing yarmulkes with a Messianic caption.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the issue independently; verify article authors and the magazine's institutional affiliation and distribution chain.

claims.label: Aayol Yakobe posted on X that the rental-plate disclosure constitutes "doxing."
claims.claim: Aayol Yakobe posted on X characterizing the rental-plate disclosure as "doxing" and describing it as "unparalleled levels of insanity" and "truly dangerous."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post URL; document whether the post remains public; identify Aayol Yakobe's institutional affiliations.

claims.label: Arynne Wexler posted on X asserting that Candace Owens began her career by doxing teenagers.
claims.claim: The host reads a post she attributes to Arynne Wexler, whom she describes as the woman at the Hamptons retreat, saying 'Candace started her career by doxing teenagers. Old habits die hard.'
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post URL and Wexler's identity/affiliation; review any contemporaneous coverage of the alleged "doxing teenagers" claim.

claims.label: Host Says Plane Owned by Turning Point USA Donor T.W. Lewis Flew Scottsdale to Provo
claims.claim: The host says a flight from Scottsdale to Provo on the day of the assassination, departing at about 8:00 local and landing at about 10:00 local, was on a plane owned by Turning Point USA donor T.W. Lewis, whose foundation website she says lists TPUSA as a recipient.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the FAA / ADS-B flight record for tail number; obtain the T.W. Lewis Foundation filings and grant log to TPUSA; identify passengers.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Extended Filing Deadline Was November 15
claims.claim: The host says her sister, an accountant, told her that if Turning Point USA filed for an extension, as the host assumes it did, its filing was due on November 15th, the Saturday before the episode, and she will keep checking the IRS website.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the IRS tax-exempt filing database for a TPUSA return posted after November 15, 2025, and the extension request date.
claims.transcript_snippet: the filing deadline if you filed for an extension, which we can assume Turning Point did, was November 15th for this year

claims.label: Host Says SU-BTT Landed in Utah Six Days Before the Assassination With 12 to 14 Egyptians
claims.claim: The host says she has confirmed a full flight, SU-BTT, landed in Utah six days before Charlie Kirk's assassination and that 12 to 14 Egyptians deplaned on September 4th.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Provo airport arrival records and CBP or customs declarations for SU-BTT on September 4, 2025, and any passenger count.
claims.transcript_snippet: SU-BTT, landed into Utah 6 days before Charlie Kirk's assassination. So, we are looking at anywhere between 12 to 14 quote unquote Egyptians that were on this flight and deplaned on September 4th.

claims.label: Host Relays State Department Source: Foreign Military Jets Landing in the US Require Federal Escort
claims.claim: The host says a high government source, identified as a person in the State Department, confirmed that a foreign military jet cannot land on American soil without the federal government noticing and that it requires a federal escort.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the State Department and FAA for the published protocol and the escort or diplomatic clearance file for SU-BTT's September 4, 2025 Provo arrival.
claims.transcript_snippet: this person in the State Department confirmed that a foreign military jet actually can't just land on American soil without the federal government paying attention.

claims.label: Host Says the Government Is Immediately Aware and Provides an Escort; Asks Who the Agents Were
claims.claim: The host says her source told her the government is immediately aware when a military-equipped foreign plane is coming in and an escort is provided, and she asks which federal agents escorted the Egyptians off the plane, adding that Kash Patel will not answer.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek records identifying the federal agency and agents that met SU-BTT in Provo, such as CBP, State Department Diplomatic Security or escort logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: The government is immediately aware that this military equipped plane is coming in and an escort is provided because they want to know where they are going, what they are doing.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Kirk Had a Photographic Memory and Loved Learning About Military Planes
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk had a photographic memory and loved military planes, so she considers it highly likely he would have recognized an Egyptian jet circling around him and Erika.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Charlie Kirk's family, staff and friends whether he commented on aircraft near his events, and look for any recorded remarks about military planes.
claims.transcript_snippet: He had a photographic memory and he loved planes. He loved learning about military planes.

claims.label: Host Says Viewers Corrected Her Reading of the Letter N and the Number Nine in Plates
claims.claim: The host says viewers emailed that she confused the letter N and the number nine when reading the rental plates on earlier episodes and says she is now reading them correctly.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the plates read on the earlier episode against the corrected plates read here and against rental company records.
claims.transcript_snippet: informed me that I apparently do not know the difference between the letter N and the number nine.

claims.label: Host Says the Egyptians Did Not Leave on SU-BTT and Waited for SU-BND to Take Them Home
claims.claim: The host says the Egyptians were not on the plane on the way out and waited for the second Egyptian military plane, SU-BND, to take them back home.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare SU-BTT's departure passenger records from Provo with SU-BND's departure records to see who boarded each.
claims.transcript_snippet: they weren't even on the plane on the way out. They waited for that anchor plane, uh, SUBND, the other Egyptian military plane, to take them back home.

claims.label: Host Floats That Cars in the Driveway of the TMZ Footage Could Be the Rented Vehicles
claims.claim: The host says viewers noted a lot of cars in the driveway of the footage of the alleged shooter that TMZ distributed, and she says it is possible some of them are the rented vehicles, such as a RAV 4.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain an unblurred copy of the original footage and compare vehicle make, model and plates to the five rental plates.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's therefore possible that some of those cars that we are looking at could be the rented vehicles, right?

claims.label: Host Says Press Reported Kent and Gabbard Were Warring With Patel's FBI
claims.claim: The host says the press reported that Joe Kent and Tulsi Gabbard were warring with the FBI or with Kash Patel and says they could look into the rental vehicles in the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the press reports describing the dispute among Kent, Gabbard and Patel and any statement by Kent or Gabbard about the Egyptian aircraft.
claims.transcript_snippet: Joe Kent and Tulsi Gabbard who are waring or at least that's what the press said waring with the FBI or waring with Kash Patel

claims.label: Host Says UVU Has Denied Every Request to Release Footage From the Day and the Days Before
claims.claim: The host says Utah Valley University has denied every request to release footage of the day of the assassination and also footage of the days leading up to it.
claims.investigative_direction: File or review public records requests to UVU for campus camera footage from September 4 to September 10, 2025, and the denial letters.
claims.transcript_snippet: the reason that UVU has denied every request not just to release footage of the day of the assassination but also to release footage of the days leading up to the assassination.

claims.label: Host Suspects the Released Footage Was Recorded Before September 10 and Staged
claims.claim: The host says she believes the footage released so far was recorded before September 10, that it may have been staged when the Egyptian planes arrived six days earlier, then edited and released to TMZ.
claims.investigative_direction: Request metadata and original files for the TMZ and UVU footage to establish recording dates, and compare clothing and lighting across clips.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's possible that they could have staged some of that, which they eventually edited maybe a bit and released it to TMZ in in that time frame.

claims.label: Host Says Students and Allegedly a Professor Reported Seeing Someone on the Roof a Week Earlier
claims.claim: The host says there were students and allegedly a professor who reported seeing someone on the roof a week earlier, that this got buried in the press, and that CNN did not include their names.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the professor and students through UVU staff and student contacts, and ask CNN whether it holds interview notes.
claims.transcript_snippet: There were students and allegedly a professor who reported seeing someone on the roof a week earlier.

claims.label: CNN Article Says Student Reported Rooftop Sightings to FBI Tip Line and Heard Nothing Back
claims.claim: The host reads from the CNN article that the student told CNN he reported his observations to the FBI tip line after the shooting but has not heard back, and that the man was looking down at the courtyard where Kirk later spoke.
claims.investigative_direction: Request FBI tip line records for the student's report and ask CNN for the original article text and date.
claims.transcript_snippet: He told CNN that he reported his observations to the FBI tip line after the shooting, but he has not heard back.

claims.label: Host Says a Viewer Tip Included a September 11 Recording of a Student Interviewed by Another Student
claims.claim: The host says a viewer sent her a recording taken on September 11th, a day after the shooting, in which a student is interviewed by another student about what he observed, and that it runs about three minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original recording and file metadata from the tipster and identify the interviewer and the interview location.
claims.transcript_snippet: This is by the way taken on September 11th. So this is a day after the shooting.

claims.label: Student in the Recording Says He Cannot Definitively Say the Man He Saw Is the Man in the Photos
claims.claim: In the recording, the student says he does not remember enough to definitively say the man he saw on the roof is the man in the pictures, though he says the man in the pictures looks similar.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-interview the student and show him the released photographs and video stills.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't think I remember enough to really definitively say that the guy I saw is the guy in the pictures

claims.label: Student in the Recording Says the Man Hopped a Railing Off the CS Building Concourse and Walked the Ledge
claims.claim: In the recording, the student describes a concourse sticking out from the computer science building that people are allowed to walk on, and says the man walked over the railing and wandered around the ledge.
claims.investigative_direction: Walk the CS building concourse and Losee Center roof area with UVU facilities staff to confirm the railing, ledge and sight lines described.
claims.transcript_snippet: And he walked over that railing and started wandering around the ledge.

claims.label: Student in the Recording Bets the Shooter Reached the Losee Center Roof via the CS Concourse
claims.claim: In the recording, the student says his bet is that the computer science building concourse connected to the law center is how the shooter got onto the Losee Center roof, noting a ladder on the other side as another way.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU building plans and access logs for the CS concourse and roof access points.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um my bet would be that that's how the shooter got onto the wazi center roof because that's one of a few ways I know of.

claims.label: Student Says a Professor Asked the Man on the Roof if He Was Okay and Walked Away
claims.claim: In the recording, the student says that on the first sighting a man he took to be a professor called up, asked the man on the roof if he was okay, was told he was fine, and walked away.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the professor through UVU faculty records for the CS building and ask what he saw.
claims.transcript_snippet: he comes from below and he shouts up, but the guy he asks like, "Are you okay?"

claims.label: Student Says It Was Definitely the Same Man Both Times, Hopping the Railing Each Time
claims.claim: In the recording, the student says the second time he saw the man do the same thing, hopping the railings and wandering around, and that it was definitely the same man on both occasions.
claims.investigative_direction: Take a signed statement from the student giving dates, times and clothing for each sighting.
claims.transcript_snippet: The second time I saw him do the same thing. He hopped the railings, started wandering around.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Identified the Student Whose Name CNN Did Not Publish
claims.claim: The host says she does not know why CNN declined to publish the student's name but that she was able to figure out who he is and will chase it down.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host's team for the student's identity and whether he consents to an on-record interview.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't know why CNN declined to publish his name, but I was able to figure out who the student was.

claims.label: Host Asks Students Who Saw Someone on the Rooftop in the Week Before to Send Tips
claims.claim: The host asks any student who saw someone on the rooftop in the days or week before the assassination to send tips to the more tips email address at candaceowens.com.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the tip inbox for rooftop-sighting reports dated September 4 to September 10, 2025, and vet each witness.
claims.transcript_snippet: If you are a student and you saw someone up on the rooftop in the days or in the week leading up to the assassination, we want to hear from you. More tips at candace Owens. com.

claims.label: Host Says Every Rooftop Lead Brings Her to a Military Person and No More Footage Has Been Released
claims.claim: The host says every time she chases leads about the rooftop she is brought to a military person, and she reasons that if the shooting happened on September 10 there would be multiple angles that authorities would have released.
claims.investigative_direction: Document which rooftop leads the host traced and the military affiliations found; request all camera angles of the roof from UVU and the FBI.
